title: A Central root cannot read review results published on a satellite (WinB): 404 "review attempt has no confirmed publication"
outcome: An eligible root on the central host (such as Engram::Merger) can read, through a supported route, the published structured result of a review attempt that ran on a satellite host (for example WinB), using the identity the author cites (host, delegation id, attempt, result id). Otherwise it receives a precise reason that names the cross-host case and a supported recovery route, so that review adoption across hosts no longer depends on mailing the bodies by hand.
acceptance: The cause of the 404 "review attempt has no confirmed publication" for the WinB-hosted round-5 review attempts of Engram w-8161763a59c8 (parent WinB session-87, reviewed commit 9b39b98d), read from Central session-11859, is established from source. Either the satellite's review custody is not visible on the central host, or another named cause applies.

A central root can read a satellite-published review result through a supported, authenticated route that keeps the result's identity, digest and eligibility checks. Or, if that is out of scope for this item, the refusal names the cross-host case and the supported recovery route, and a follow-up item is filed for the read route.

A behavioural test with a fake federation link covers the established case (a satellite-published attempt read from the central host). No text-pinning test. The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium or higher finding and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
